rlpso_compact_policy_declared_reconstruc.implemented_policy: seeded linear categorical actor with immediate-reward policy-gradient update
rlpso_compact_policy_declared_reconstruc.claim_boundary: RPSO-derived engineering proxy only; no source replay, full PPO, paper reproduction, or author-policy claim.

remaining_t42_completion: A separate seeded C++ implementation of the complete 2-256-64 actor/critic PPO lifecycle is required before T42 is marked complete.

physical_fes.training: every action-reward candidate invokes and counts one complete-layout evaluation
physical_fes.inference: initial population, exemplar trials, and updated population each count one complete-layout evaluation per layout
physical_fes.total: training plus inference; execution stops exactly at the supplied budget

parallel_semantics: population construction, repair, and independent evaluation use the persistent CPU team; policy update and ordered selection are deterministic
source_redistribution: No-license public source is used as an oracle and is not vendored.
